title: About Dr. Gabriella González Pane
subtitle: Twenty years of conservative dentistry, written plans, and honest second opinions — in Spanish and English.
fraseGuia: Dentistry doesn't start with a drill. It starts by thinking.

sections.heading: Who she is
sections.body: I'm Dr. Gabriella González Pane. Dentist specializing in Oral Rehabilitation, Aesthetics and Restorative Dentistry. I've practiced for over twenty years, and spent thirteen of them seeing patients at Odontología 3 in Asunción, where I learned to read thousands of mouths and recognize patterns that only show up with time. Today I'm building an independent practice where I can work the way I think: think before touching, preserve before replacing, explain before selling.

sections.heading: Guiding phrase
sections.body: Dentistry doesn't start with a drill. It starts by thinking. That sentence summarizes everything: every treatment begins with observation, clinical history, diagnosis, reading the tissues, understanding the patient and analyzing future consequences.

sections.heading: The 5 non-negotiable pillars
items: Think before touching — diagnosis, conversation and planning before any procedure.
Preserve before replacing — every preserved tooth structure is preferable to every lost one.
Explain before selling — the patient must understand. Educate without infantilizing.
See people before teeth — the mouth belongs to someone with fear, budget and history.
Refer when appropriate — a confident professional doesn't need to do everything.

sections.heading: How she thinks about a case
sections.body: When a patient says "I want to replace this crown", I don't look only at the crown. I look at the substrate, the neighboring tooth, the age, the function, the occlusion, the endodontic history, the risk of touching a vital tooth, and the real expectation. When I see a broken molar, I don't ask only how to restore it. I ask whether it's vital, whether it's restorable, where the margin ends, how it will be isolated, what happens to adjacent teeth, and what the prognosis is. Treatment comes from a map, not an impulse.

sections.heading: The symbol: never underestimate a small spot
sections.body: A small-appearing lesion can hide much greater destruction. It's not about opening everything out of fear; it's about interpreting the finding in the patient's context. This sentence shows my value: not looking at the obvious, but understanding what could be happening underneath.

sections.heading: What the brand never says
sections.body: I don't sell "no-prep veneers", guaranteed perfect smiles, unbeatable prices, risk-free treatment, or "change your life in one appointment". What I do offer: "before deciding, let's understand your case". "Not always the most visible treatment is the most indicated". "A good clinical decision can prevent many future problems".

sections.heading: Outside the chair
sections.body: I live in Luque. I wear colorful scrubs. I've been using AI for years to analyze my cases and finances. I'm building a space where private care with clinical judgment has a place in Paraguay — for patients who are tired of having procedures sold to them without the why being explained.

sections.heading: Training and practice
bullets: ~20 years in restorative dentistry, aesthetics, and oral rehabilitation.
Volume: ~130 patients/month, 42 restorations in May 2026 alone.

manifiestoCorto: I don't want patients to choose me because I promise a perfect smile. I want them to choose me because they trust how I think. That is the center of the brand: think before touching.
